## Description
Briefly describe the change, rationale, and motivation.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Benchmark / performance optimization

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] All unit tests pass (`pytest -v tests/`)
- [ ] Empirical benchmark verified (`python -m backend.run_benchmark`)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or credentials introduced
- [ ] Safety boundary respected (No autonomous machine actuation)

## Related Issues
Fixes #(issue)
